intent: A refined dark product footer: hairline link grid lit from inside by the pointer, a breathing status pill, a gliding 3-way theme switch and a locale listbox. Collapses to an accordion on narrow containers.

stack.styling: Tailwind CSS v4 with container queries
stack.animation: motion/react (layoutId thumbs, accordion, popover) + one rAF loop writing CSS variables for the light

layout.root: footer is the @container; bg #050505; full-bleed top border white/8%; content max-w 1280px, gutters 20/32/40px
layout.grid: @5xl: minmax(0,1.5fr) repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr)); @2xl: brand row full width (brand left, release pill right) over 4 equal columns; <640px: accordion
layout.hairlines: white/9% 1px: frame sides, a divider before each link column, rule under brand row at @2xl only; bottom rule spans 100cqw
layout.brandCell: 24px mark + 18px name; 15px description max 30ch; release pill pinned to bottom with margin-top auto; padding 40/32/48
layout.column: padding 32/24/40; mono 11px heading; 20px gap; 32px link rows
layout.bottomBar: status pill + mono copyright left; locale + theme right; 20px vertical padding
layout.mobile: 56px disclosure rows with plus→minus; open list is a 2-col grid of 44px links; bottom bar stacks status, then locale+theme (50px tall), then copyright

color.popover: #0d0d0e with white/9% inset ring and 0 24px 60px -12px rgba(0,0,0,.9)

motion.light: mouse only; rAF lerp 0.2 position, 0.12 intensity; each cell paints radial-gradient(400px circle at pointer-minus-offset: white/10% → 4.5% at 32% → 1.2% at 58% → transparent 75%); hovered cell 100%, others 32% (eased 0.16); vertical dividers overlay a 150px white/50% radial; top/bottom rules glow along x; cached offsets; loop stops when settled
motion.linkHover: siblings dim to white/40 via group-has-[a:hover]; 150ms colour; press 1px down
motion.status: breathing halo scale 1→2.6, opacity .55→0; 3.2s ok, 2.2s degraded, 1.4s outage; dot colour tween 400ms; label cross-fade 6px + 3px blur
motion.themeSwitch: layoutId thumb, spring stiffness 500 damping 40; press 0.94
motion.locale: opens upward: opacity + 6px rise + scale .97→1, 220ms ease-out; exit 140ms ease-in; option highlight glides via layoutId; chevron rotates 180° in 220ms
motion.accordion: height auto↔0 360ms ease-out; opacity 300/180ms; plus stroke rotates 90° and fades
motion.reveal: once at 25% in view: cells rise 14px + fade, 600ms, 60ms stagger
motion.reducedMotion: no reveal, no breathing, light snaps, instant accordion and popover

responsive.desktop: brand cell + 4 columns in one row (≥1024px container)
responsive.mobile: accordion below 640px; 44px+ targets; theme buttons 44px; light disabled for touch

accessibility: each column is a nav labelled by its heading
disclosure buttons use aria-expanded and aria-controls; collapsed lists are inert
theme switch is a radiogroup with roving tabindex and arrow keys
locale is a button with aria-haspopup=listbox and a listbox with aria-activedescendant; Escape returns focus
external links announce (opens in a new tab)

content.brand: Halyard: queues, cron and webhooks that retry until they land
content.columns: Product (Queues, Cron, Webhooks, Workflows [New], Pricing); Developers (Documentation, API reference, CLI, Changelog, GitHub ↗); Company (About, Customers, Careers [4 open], Blog, Contact); Legal (Terms, Privacy, DPA, Sub-processors, Security)
content.status: All systems normal / Degraded performance / Partial outage
content.locales: en-US, en-GB, de-DE, fr-FR, es-MX, pt-BR, ja-JP

avoid: a glow around the whole footer
a two-state checkbox for a three-way theme
